lines.en: I float slowly through the air.

lines.zh: 我的眼白占了大半个身子。
lines.en: The white of my eye is most of me.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，瞳孔跟着火光。
lines.en: I hover, my pupil tracking your torchlight.
I sink below the cloud.
My pupil stays on you.

lines.zh: 空气被我推着往两边走。
lines.en: The air moves aside as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的眼白映出整片村子。
lines.en: My eye white reflects the whole village.

lines.zh: 我压过树梢，叶子全朝下。
lines.en: I press over the treetops and every leaf turns down.

lines.zh: 我在树顶上方停了一下。
lines.en: I pause above the treetops.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上滑过去。
lines.en: My shadow slides over the ground.

lines.zh: 我的眼泪落下去，是暗红的。
lines.en: My tears fall dark red.
I watch until I have seen enough.
My lids move very slowly.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛比我的身体还大。
lines.en: The eye is bigger than the body.

lines.zh: 第二形态的壳还在眼皮底下。
lines.en: The second form's shell waits beneath my lid.
There is a raw smell in the air.

lines.zh: 我眨一次眼，地上就黑一片。
lines.en: Each blink darkens a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 你的心跳从草房那边传上来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat rises from the cottage.

lines.zh: 我不需要落地，也不需要休息。
lines.en: I need neither ground nor rest.

lines.zh: 我的注视让你不舒服吧。
lines.en: My gaze troubles you.

lines.zh: 我在等第二阶段的开始。
lines.en: I wait for the second stage.
My blood is dark red.
I keep this sky.
Look up and there I am.
I hang over your roof ridge.
Quiet, but for the wings.
You see me. Do not look away.
This eye looks only at you.

lines.zh: 你想不想知道我在想什么？
lines.en: Want to know what I am thinking?
You smell fresh.
I can wait a very long time.

lines.zh: 你举着武器，挡不住注视。
lines.en: That weapon stops no gaze.
The sky here is wrong, is it not?
I am already above you.
You retreat. I drift after.
My pupil just narrowed.
You are not ready.
I will end this night.
My lid twitches.
Blood runs down my eye white into the pupil.
My pupil resets.
Blood runs from my eye's corner.
A blood thread in the white.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的眼角，视线歪了。
lines.en: You strike my eye corner and my gaze skews.
My gaze breaks for an instant.
I turn back to you.

lines.zh: 第二层壳还没裂，你急什么。
lines.en: The second shell has not cracked; why hurry?
Still here. Eye still open.
Food? I do not eat that.

lines.zh: 那只眼睛里，只装得下血。
lines.en: That eye has room only for blood.
This eye favors only blood.
Put it down. Do not waste the effort.
Your offering is too small.
I need no sacrifice.
Too high. I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 七百二十八点生命，一眼就够了。
lines.en: Seven hundred twenty-eight health; one eye is enough.

lines.zh: 供品太小，连我的瞳孔都照不满。
lines.en: The offering is too small to fill even my pupil.
Keep it. That is not what I want.
You hit an eyeball.

lines.zh: 我退开一点，眼睛还对着你。
lines.en: I drift back, still facing you.
Soft body. Heavy.
You are thrown a few blocks.
Do not touch my pupil.
The bump made me blink.
I tilt and you miss again.

lines.zh: 我的眼球擦过你的盾沿。
lines.en: My eyeball grazes the rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 我退半格，瞳孔仍锁着你。
lines.en: I retreat half a block, pupil still locked on you.
That only woke me further.

lines.zh: 我在半空里转，找你的破口。
lines.en: I wheel in the air, looking for a gap.
This eye only watches the world.
I do not appear often.
You ask too closely.
I have only gazing and charging.

lines.zh: 这种问题会让我更想靠近。
lines.en: That makes me want to come closer.
I do not continue. I repeat.

lines.zh: 你身后那东西，也许知道。
lines.en: The thing behind you may know.
Stop asking. Just watch.
Silence suits better.
That meat is useless to me.
I blow your fallen thing aside.

lines.zh: 那东西被我扔进树冠里。
lines.en: I fling the thing up into the canopy.
Too small. I cannot see it.
My wind pushes it away.
Iron on the ground is not in my eye.
That eye is not yours.
I collect gazes, not things.
Things on the ground rot.
Leave it. Let the night be busier.

lines.zh: 克苏鲁之眼，瞳孔对准你。
lines.en: The Eye of Cthulhu fixes its pupil on you.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩起来了，这是开始。
lines.en: My pupil narrows. It begins.
My eye locks on you.
I dive from beneath the clouds; the wind arrives first.
First charge. Short.

lines.zh: 你听见那种低沉的声音吗？
lines.en: Hear that low sound?
I begin to descend.
You turn and see me.
This eye pursues one target.
The more you run, the more eager I am.
No cover on the ground.
My pupil narrows to hold only you.
Raise the shield. It will not help.
Tonight I do not hold back.
You are panting. Good.
I drop low to charge.
Hear the wings?

lines.zh: 你的后颈，我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: The back of your neck is perfectly clear to me.
Now look up.
You cannot dodge this.
I circle, dropping slowly.
My gaze presses on you.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就近一点。
lines.en: Each step back, I close in.
The ground is quiet but for you.
I pause, then charge.
Under a tree is not enough.
My pupil narrows to a slit.

lines.zh: 你听得见空气被切开吗？
lines.en: Hear the air part?
Ten blocks up, descending.

lines.zh: 你转向哪边，瞳孔就跟到哪边。
lines.en: Wherever you turn, my pupil follows.

lines.zh: 你往左躲，我的瞳孔也左。
lines.en: You dodge left, and my pupil goes left.
Armor stops no eyeball.
One beat more and we collide.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我飘得比你快。
lines.en: No chase. I drift faster.
Your shadow shrinks.
I am directly above.

lines.zh: 整片夜色里只剩下你的呼吸。
lines.en: Only your breathing is left in the night.
Hear your own heart?
I open my eye: second phase.
Now look at me.
I dive and slam into you.
One impact and you are airborne.
That carried force.
You hit a tree and still slide.

lines.zh: 我的边缘划开了你的护甲。
lines.en: My rim splits your armor.
The air cracks with it.

lines.zh: 我又升起来，准备第二次。
lines.en: I rise for a second pass.

lines.zh: 你挡住了一次，还有下一次。
lines.en: One blocked. More coming.
Your shield is dented.
That was no light blow.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，血滴在地上。
lines.en: Half a step back; blood on the dirt.
I drift away and watch.
The second charge is longer.

lines.zh: 你不用抬头，我知道你在哪。
lines.en: No need to look up. I know.
A gap opens in the sky.

lines.zh: 月亮被什么东西挡住了。
lines.en: Something covers the moon.
An eye opens in midair.
One low note.
The night goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我的注视落在这片地上。
lines.en: My gaze falls on this ground.

lines.zh: 气流开始往一个方向转。
lines.en: The air starts to turn.
I emerge from behind the clouds.
I will watch this sky.

lines.zh: 我在月亮的位置睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eye where the moon should be.

lines.zh: 一只巨大的眼悬在你头上。
lines.en: A vast eye hangs over you.
My pupil opens for the first time.

lines.zh: 草地上铺开一片眼形的影子。
lines.en: An eye-shaped shadow spreads on the grass.
Every sound retreats.
You look up and meet me.

lines.zh: 半空里，一只眼睛睁开了。
lines.en: In midair, an eye has opened.
My wings scrape the air.
The dark itself has changed.
Ten blocks above you.
I rise, my pupil on you.

lines.zh: 火光里，我的瞳孔缩得很小。
lines.en: In firelight my pupil shrinks.

lines.zh: 我落下去，又慢慢浮起来。
lines.en: I drop, then float back up.

lines.zh: 水面下，我的眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: Under water, my eye stays open.
The blast pushes me far off.
An arrow in the white of my eye.

lines.zh: 法术让我的注视短暂地断了。
lines.en: Arts break my gaze briefly.

lines.zh: 我看不到血，就越来越淡。
lines.en: No blood in sight and I dim.

lines.zh: 落雷撕开云层，照见我的眼。
lines.en: Lightning tears the cloud and shows my eye.

lines.zh: 下方没有地面，只有虚空。
lines.en: No ground below. Only void.
